facts.statement: Wargosuchus is an extinct genus of baurusuchid crocodyliforms that lived in Argentina during the Late Cretaceous.
facts.quote: Wargosuchus (meaning "warg crocodile") is an extinct genus of baurusuchid crocodyliforms from the Late Cretaceous of Argentina.

facts.statement: The genus was described by Agustín Martinelli and Diego Pais in 2008 based on a fragmentary skull found near Neuquén in the Santonian-age Bajo de la Carpa Formation.
facts.quote: It is known from a fragmentary skull from the Santonian-age Bajo de la Carpa Formation of the Neuquén Group, found in the vicinity of Neuquén, Neuquén Province, and was described by Agustín Martinelli and Diego Pais in 2008.

facts.statement: The only known species is the type species Wargosuchus australis.
facts.quote: The type species, and so far the only species, is Wargosuchus australis.

facts.statement: The fossil record consists of MOZ-PV 6134, which includes a partial right premaxilla, maxilla, and skull roof.
facts.quote: Wargosuchus is based on MOZ-PV 6134, a partial right premaxilla and maxilla, and partial skull roof.
The animal had a robust skull.

facts.statement: Researchers identified Wargosuchus by specific skull features including a midline groove on the frontal bones, a large depression for olfactory bulbs, and an enlarged premaxillary tooth followed by a deep pit for the lower jaw tooth.
facts.quote: Martinelli and Pais distinguished Wargosuchus from other mesoeucrocodylians by skull details, such as a deep groove on the midline of the frontal bones, a large depression for the olfactory bulbs, and enlargement of the last tooth of the premaxilla followed by a deep pit for the following tooth of the lower jaw.

facts.statement: Wargosuchus lived alongside four other mesoeucrocodylian taxa: the common Notosuchus and the rare Cynodontosuchus, Lomasuchus, and Gasparinisuchus.
facts.quote: It shared its setting with four other taxa of mesoeucrocodylians: common Notosuchus, and rare Cynodontosuchus, Lomasuchus, and Gasparinisuchus.

facts.statement: Wargosuchus belongs to the parent group Pissarrachampsinae.
Wargosuchus is classified within the family Baurusuchidae.
Wargosuchus is classified as a reptile.
Wargosuchus lived during the Santonian stage, approximately 85.7 to 83.6 million years ago.
facts.quote: Time range: Santonian to Santonian (85.7 to 83.6 million years ago)
